thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] hosted-api us-east queue alert — sustained queue growth and GPU pool saturation detected. Severity: high. https://redwood.monitoring/alerts/1768670000

emma_oncall: Ack. I'm oncall. Spike started ~23:12 UTC, p95/p99 climbing rapidly.

raj_infra: Confirmed: us-east-1a GPU pool at 100%. Autoscaler failing with provider errors: `403 QuotaExceeded: GPUS quota reached`. Provisioner retries every 6s and failing.

maria_sre: Do we have fallback routing enabled? Can we route new requests to us-east-1b / us-east-2 immediately? :thinking_face:

leo_eng_runtime: We do but it's conservative (5m sustained). I can force a global routing override: `PATCH /routing/policies/hosted?force=true` — will add latency for some routes.

emma_oncall: Force it. Also degrade non-SLA tiers to a smaller quantized variant to free slots. Apply now.

leo_eng_runtime: Done. Override id=ovr-176867. Degraded non-enterprise -> `redwood/7b-q4f` for lower tiers.

ops_bot: Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/hosted-queue-exhaustion (section 2: immediate mitigations).

raj_infra: Autoscaler log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T23:13:05Z autoscaler ERROR create-instance failed: 403 QuotaExceeded
2026-03-17T23:13:11Z autoscaler DEBUG retrying in 6s
2026-03-17T23:13:17Z autoscaler WARN pool imbalance: us-east-1a saturated, 1b healthy
```

maria_sre: Working plan: (1) force fallback routing (done), (2) skim bursty API keys with short-term throttles, (3) pull capacity from warm-pool in us-east-1b, (4) open quota case with provider.

support_jordan: Pulling impacted customers now (top errors). Preparing a status banner template in case we hit threshold.

emma_oncall: I'm applying a rate limit for flagged bursty keys: `250 r/s per key` for keys exceeding baseline. Implementing token bucket now.

leo_eng_runtime: Also toggled aggressive KV prefix caching to reduce per-request decoding. `cache.policy=aggressive` applied to hosted default routes.

raj_infra: Kicking warm-pool allocation: `provisioner allocate --pool warm-us-east-1b --count 8`. Warm-pool returned 6 ready, 2 pending.

maria_sre: Quota case opened with provider: CS-33455 requesting +24 GPUs to us-east region. ETA 3-6 hours for manual review.

emma_oncall: Metrics after routing override + warm-pool: queue.len 11900 -> 4200, p95 2400ms -> 900ms, p99 8300ms -> 2100ms (prelim from dashboard). Errors trending down.

ops_bot: Reminder: follow runbook sec 4 for customer comms & compliance checks.

support_jordan: Sent emails to three affected mid-market customers; status page draft prepared: "Increased latency/errors in us-east; routing and mitigations in progress."

maria_sre: On-call handoff in 15m. Emma, list any open action items?

emma_oncall: Handoff notes -> routing override ov-176867, quota case CS-33455, throttled keys list at /internal/throttled-keys, warm-pool status page. If queue exceeds 10k again escalate to execs and enable dedicated fallback for top SLA customers.

maria_sre: Taking over. I'll keep the routing override active and monitor p99 and autoscaler logs. If warm-pool doesn't cover demand, we'll failover highest-tier tenants to dedicated capacity.

leo_eng_runtime: Also enabling SDK graceful degradation to return truncated responses where acceptable to further reduce decode time.

support_jordan: Status page updated: "Mitigations underway: traffic rerouted and lower-tier model variants deployed; some customers may notice reduced quality or higher latency."

maria_sre: Quick checkpoint 23:32 UTC: queue=3800, inflight=1600, p95=850ms, p99=1900ms. Warm-pool stabilized at 6 GPUs.

emma_oncall: Thanks — staying available if anything regresses.

maria_sre: If stable for 30m with p99 < 2s we'll remove routing override and revert variant-degrade and cache changes. Leaving monitoring until 00:10 UTC.

ops_bot: Incident annotated: type=capacity-exhaustion, root_cause=provider GPU quota + AZ saturation, mitigations=[fallback-routing, warm-pool, throttling, variant-degrade, cache-tuning].

support_jordan: I'll follow up with affected customers and prepare postmortem draft once we confirm root cause & timeline.

maria_sre: Final update 23:58 UTC: queue steady ~600, p95 430ms, p99 720ms. Warm-pool still 6; quota pending. Leaving routing override active until quota resolved or normal capacity returns."
